title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-08
source: source: aud reel master taped by Marty Weinberg; akg d190e > uher 4000L; transferred by Michael Parish; the following were used as patch sources: Jerry Moore's 1st gen reel of Marty's mar and Ken Lee's aud cassette master; assembled by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: A well‑edited matrix composite of a November ’70 run that captures a playful show with highlights like Rosalie McFall, Casey Jones, Truckin’ and an inventive Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The compilation blends the best available soundboard and audience sources, pitch‑corrected where needed, delivering a generally listenable recording despite occasional edits and missing crowd ambience. Musically the night is quirky – an acoustic first set with solid folk renditions followed by an electric second set that climbs from average early cuts to high points on Casey Jones, Truckin’ and a sci‑fi Dark Star jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split between strong praise for the upgraded composite and criticism of heavy editing; overall performance is viewed as above average with a good but not flawless recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Composite of multiple sources, pitch‑corrected (+1% in places); generally clear and listenable but suffers from occasional missing crowd noise, edited-out tunings, and a noisy audience bleed on Ripple.

poor_songs: Operator (final version, noted as not one of the better takes)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic first set is quirky and folk‑focused; electric second set starts average but gains momentum with Casey Jones and Truckin', peaking in a creative Dark Star jam before winding down with experimental new material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s solo on Mystery Train is highlighted as a classic solo moment.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir “gives his all” on New Orleans, even shouting ‘slow down!’ during the performance.
